LanguageData.Binguin_LaserGatling.label: GGGGGG
LanguageData.Binguin_LaserGatling.description:
Glacier Goose Giga-Gust Graser Gatling.
The ultimate creation of the Frostspeaker: an eight-barrel laser gatling. Once it spins up, it trails an aurora that never fades. Each shot is weak (2 damage), yet thirty laser bolts pour out every second, and the ultimate ice burst doubles down on every hit (4% freeze chance per bolt) to sculpt the enemy into snow statues. Suppression 0.5. (Costs 8 advanced components / 60 plasteel / 200 steel)
LanguageData.Recipe_Binguin_LaserGatling.label: Craft GGGGGG

LanguageData.Binguin_FloatMenuOptionProviderDiplomacy: The diplomat is no longer waiting here.
LanguageData.Binguin_GameComponentDiplomacy_06: Contact with the mothership is already underway or complete.
LanguageData.Binguin_GameComponentDiplomacy_08: The binguin large signal transmitter puts out an immense signal, tearing across the heavens to call the mothership in deep space.\n\n
LanguageData.Binguin_GameComponentDiplomacy_09: Such an immense signal is certain to draw prying eyes - expect within 13 days
LanguageData.Binguin_GameComponentDiplomacy_10: waves of far heavier raids than usual. Hold out until the mothership answers.
LanguageData.Binguin_GameComponentDiplomacy_12: The large signal transmitter has been destroyed, and contact with the mothership is severed. Build a new transmitter to try again.
LanguageData.Binguin_GameComponentDiplomacy_14: A long answer comes back from deep space. The binguin mothership has confirmed your coordinates, and the course is lit.\n\n
LanguageData.Binguin_GameComponentDiplomacy_15: Now, have your colonists enter the ship-type launch pod, then ignite it—fly to the stars and reach the binguin sky-ending.
LanguageData.Binguin_GameComponentDiplomacy_17: The launch pod ignites, flame lifts the hull, and it pierces the heavens.\n\n
LanguageData.Binguin_GameComponentDiplomacy_18:
Aboard the binguin ship, through cloud, ionosphere, and a billion stars—
the mothership's gangway is already unfurled beneath the starlight.
LanguageData.Binguin_GameComponentDiplomacy_22: And to every colonist who has walked alongside the binguin.
LanguageData.Binguin_GameComponentDiplomacy_24: The mothership is not yet linked, so launch is impossible.
LanguageData.Binguin_GameComponentDiplomacy_25: No colonist has entered the launch pod.
LanguageData.Binguin_GameComponentDiplomacy_28: The diplomat pushes the round-framed glasses up her nose, unrolls the scroll, and reads the closing lines of the observation log:\n\n
LanguageData.Binguin_GameComponentDiplomacy_29: "The binguin civilization, from a world of bitter winter, dwells for a time upon a rimworld, and "for now" has no wish to quarrel."\n\n
LanguageData.Binguin_GameComponentDiplomacy_30: She lifts her head and looks to you: "And so—would your colony be willing to coexist with us?"
LanguageData.Binguin_GameComponentDiplomacy_31: The binguin diplomat closes the parchment and gives you a slight bow: "Neutrality, too, may be a neighbor. May we trouble one another not."\n\nAfter a brief stay in the colony, she sets out for the ice fields.
LanguageData.Binguin_GameComponentDiplomacy_32: The binguin diplomat's expression dims at once. She presses her lips together and says softly: "...I understand. May the cold wave knock no more at your door."\n\nShe turns, walks past the colony's edge, and vanishes into the driving snow.
LanguageData.Binguin_GameComponentDiplomacy_33: The binguin diplomat gravely places a roll of parchment in your hands: "This is most well. May our observation posts keep watch over the same starfield together."\n\nAfter lingering in the colony for a time, she sets out for the ice fields.
LanguageData.Binguin_GameComponentDiplomacy_35: A penguin girl calling herself a binguin diplomat has arrived at the colony's edge. Clad in black and white down, she has come to ask your colony's intent regarding "coexistence."\n\nShe will wait at the colony's edge. Select a colonist, right-click the diplomat, and speak with her.

LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_01: Q: What's the scariest weather in RimWorld? A: A solar flare - because once the computer loses power, the game just shuts off.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_02: A colonist dug a pit for the raiders and put up a sign: "Please form an orderly queue to jump in." The raiders were deeply moved, and walked around it.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_58: After a pigskin was made into a backpack, nobody ever asked what was inside it again.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_03: The caravan came and went. The colonist looked at the bill and decided to become a raider next time.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_04: Why do so few people in the RimWorld keep pets? Wait until the dog eats a red candy and you'll understand.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_59: Impids are called devils - not because impids are all that dangerous, but because they genuinely live a hellish life.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_127: Ty made trouble outside as a kid, and his parents found out at the office immediately.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_05: "We have numbers!" the raiders shout. "We have mortars," the colonist replies. "We have hostages!" "We have mortars."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_06: The insectoid swarm arrives and the colonists hide indoors. The bugs chew through the wall for two days and then find the door was unlocked.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_60: A handler tries to train a boomrat. It works - it becomes the colony's most popular "firework".
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_61: Eating animal meat is barbaric by yttakin standards, so they live on outsiders instead.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_07: The recipe for nutrient paste is classified, but everyone guesses it's at least 33% "unknown".
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_08: When a solar flare hits, the whole colony gropes around in the dark.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_62: How do you make a waster prisoner happy? Kill every other waster prisoner captured alongside him.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_09: Q: Why are there fewer and fewer berries in the RimWorld? A: Because every colonist keeps a pig.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_10: The mortar team aims for three days, finally fires, and hits its own storeroom. "That's how you keep your wealth down," they say.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_74: A prisoner is caught escaping. "Why?" the guard asks. "The food is terrible." "Then why not just die?" "What's the difference between Milila's cooking and death?"
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_63: Hussars are called hussars, yet none of them have horses - probably because hussars can't train animals at all.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_64: To fix their stubby fingers, pigskins poured everything into research and fitted their elite with bionic arms. But pigskins only know hands with stubby fingers, so the bionic arms were built with stubby fingers too...
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_75: A colonist hears the rattkin tower shields are tough, so he gets one - and finds it only covers his forearm.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_11: A trade caravan arrives and the colonist greets them warmly. The trader checks the manifest: "Your 'fresh human meat' is expired."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_65: If you have an older brother who is a neanderthal, whatever you do, don't call him...
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_66: A raider army closes in. The colonist calmly sips tea and calls the mechanoids.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_12: The carnivores of the RimWorld will eat your colonists, but at least they'll say something first... no, they can't talk.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_67: Q: How do you calm a boomrat down? A: Don't touch it. Q: How do you calm it down even more? A: Send it to the raider camp.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_76: Apparently Monoling had a baptismal font custom-made for the rattkin, so they wouldn't drown.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_13: The solar flare ends and the colonists cheer. The freezer says: "What are you so happy about? All my meat thawed for nothing."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_14: A colonist hauls 180 kg of steel into the storeroom and comes out carrying stone blocks, one at a time.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_15: Colonist: "Doctor, I think I've caught a cold." Doctor: "No problem, I'm very good at amputations."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_128: Ty's country can hand-build starships, yet still has to run to the neighbouring country to buy reinforced barrels.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_16: Landmine: "I'm hidden." Raider: "So am I." Colonist: "Stop chatting, you've both blown up."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_17: A colonist child is drawing. That's nothing unusual - except he's doing it in the freezer...
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_68: A boomalope faces off against a raider. Raider: "Come at me!" Boomalope: "Come at me!" Raider: "Then let's both stand still."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_18: A colonist keeps a flock of chickens, and the chickens eat the entire freezer. The raiders have since awarded them the title "senior spy".
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_129: Ty's elder relative had a heart attack and died on their birthday.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_19: Doctor: "The patient needs surgery." Colonist: "What materials?" Doctor: "A new lung." Colonist: "We've got a 'volunteer' in the storeroom."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_20: Raider scout reports: "The colony has 20 turrets." Leader: "We'll go another day." Next day: "They have 25 now."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_69: Is the dog the RimWorld's most loyal companion? No - it's the metalhorror. Look how much work it does for you, and it never complains.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_21: A colonist asks a wise man: "How do I become happy?" The wise man points at a fresh corpse: "Make your troubles into a hat, and you will be."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_77: An evil Chinese pink four-breasted hexaceratops...
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_130: Ty's house caught fire as a kid. The firefighters couldn't put it out because no home area had been drawn.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_22: The colony hits a food crisis. The cook serves a plate of "nutrient paste sashimi". Colonist: "Is this edible?" Cook: "Yes. Just don't ask about the ingredients."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_23: A maddened bison charges into the colony. The colonist's assessment: "It looks like it's in a hurry - probably late to become nutrient paste."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_24: A prisoner writes his memoirs in his cell. Chapter one: why I shouldn't have raided a colony with three people and fifty turrets.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_25: Colonist: "I will conquer the world!" On day four he dies to a maddened rabbit.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_131: Ty wandered the streets as a kid while a gunfight broke out.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_26: A tribal raider is captured. Asked why he attacked, he says: "We're short a good tailor." The colonist: "Perfect timing - I'm short a new coat."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_27: A mechanoid army attacks and the colonists deploy a psychic insanity lance. Mechanoid: "We have no minds." Colonist: "Really."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_70: The chimera was living a comfortable life in its pit, until green rain started falling from the sky.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_78: One binguin asks another: "Why do you think the colonists keep staring at our down?" "Because it's excellent insulation material."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_79: A penguin waddles along. A colonist asks why it doesn't fly. Penguin: "If I could fly, I wouldn't be here."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_132: Ty was shot in the head with a sniper rifle as a kid. Luckily his nose stopped the bullet.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_80: A colonist tries to teach a penguin to fire a mortar. It learns fast - it just has to go "Hmph!" before every shot.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_81: On the ice sheet a penguin meets a polar bear. Penguin: "I skate really fast." Polar bear: "I eat penguins really fast." Penguin: "Then let's race home."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_28: The Frostspeaker tells a joke and the whole colony shivers - then they realise the heater is broken.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_133: Ty's family wanted to carve a road through a mountain. Thirty years later the thick roof is still coming down.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_82: A penguin chick asks its mother: "Why do we live somewhere so cold? We have to wear so many clothes." Mother: "Because in warm places, humans wear us."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_83: A binguin diplomat brings a crate of observation data abroad. Colonist: "What's this?" Diplomat: "We spent ten years counting stars, and finally finished - the stars don't count us."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_84: A colonist wraps a scarf around a penguin. "I'm a binguin, not some cold-shy penguin!" it says, and quietly tightens the scarf.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_85: Why don't binguins keep dogs? Because a dog on the ice sheet becomes a bingo - and a bingo can't fill in for a hotdog.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_86: A penguin chef invents iced nutrient paste. The colonists dig in and declare: "Doesn't burn going down."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_87: A binguin secretly practises cold jokes. After three days of practice, the entire race is frozen solid.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_88: A colonist asks a binguin: "Why are all your houses made of ice?" Binguin: "So I don't have to move the house when I move."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_134: Ty secretly played with his parents' phone as a kid, and found it had a biocode.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_135: Ty was hunted by a warg as a kid. Instead of running, he punched it - so the warg would go manhunter and forget to eat him.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_89: Binguins invented a fridge that needs no power - just leave the door open.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_136: Ty's mother told him to study hard. He said he couldn't, because research is a long-term job.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_90: The sandweaver race can't fart, or they'd be mistaken for a rattlesnake.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_91: A penguin plucks its own feathers at the South Pole, and the polar bear sues it for infringement.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_29: The Frostspeaker eats a mint before telling jokes, because it makes things feel "cooler".
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_92: Look, there's a penguin over there... oh wait, no, that's a night heron?
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_30: A cold joke, currently in progress...
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_93: Binguin warriors never look back - because looking back makes them trip.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_94: Binguins have no aircraft, but they have plenty of air force.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_95: A penguin walks into a barber shop. "What style?" the barber asks. "Give me a tuxedo cut."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_96: All the races hold a summit. The host announces: "Today's agenda is how to make the colony less cold." Everyone votes to have the binguins talk less.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_97: Binguin soldier reports: "Sir, we froze three centipedes!" "Excellent. How?" "They were eavesdropping on our cold jokes!"
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_31: Q: Why are there no mosquitoes in the RimWorld? A: They hogged too much TPS and lagged themselves to death.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_98: A dragon girl barges into the colony. Colonist: "Are you here to join us?" Dragon girl: "I'm here to eat your lawn." Colonist: "We only have twisted-meat-flavoured kibble."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_32: A solar panel says to the sun: "Let's do our best again today!" Sun: "I'm clean energy."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_99: How do you know a rattkin raided the kitchen? Because only the bottom shelf is empty.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_100: Does a Monoling without a terminal count as brain-dead?
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_137: Ty got treated as an enemy by his parents just for crying a few times.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_101: A jiangshi plays dead during thunderstorms, because feigning death wards off lightning.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_33: Raider asks the surrendering colonist: "What's your secret weapon?" Colonist: "Overtime."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_34: Two colonists argue over which came first, the chicken or the egg. A third says: "Either way it ends up as nutrient paste."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_138: Ty desecrated a peace ritual between two major gangs as a kid, and two hundred enforcers chased him for three blocks.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_35: A colony newbie asks a veteran: "What matters most in a fight?" Veteran: "Surviving." "How do I do that?" "Don't die."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_102: The wolfin insist they're wolves, not dogs - even though they keep saying "I'm dog-tired."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_36: A colonist plants potatoes. That night they're stolen. The next day he plants a field of potato mines.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_103: "Fair-weather friends" is considered a slur against the foxkin and the wolfin.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_139: Ty's family tree has to be rewritten every few days, because every few days he has more relatives.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_104: Someone once tried to stop the foxkin from smoking weed. They failed - because weed is still more normal than streaking.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_105: Which race walks the least steadily? The foxkin - because foxes are sly.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_37: The colonists long deeply for the happy life of hell.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_106: The power goes out and Milila cooks in the dark, mistaking dish soap for soy sauce. The colonists finish the meal and say: "That was refreshingly oil-free."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_107: Q: How do you make Milila's cooking taste good? A: Run it through the nutrient paste dispenser twice.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_38: A colonist tries to teach a parrot to say "Raiders!" The parrot learns to say "We surrender."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_39: The colony children build a snowman in front of a turret. "Is this an attack?" the turret asks. Snowman: "I'm here to apply for the doorman job."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_108: Milila tries to learn stir-fry, and throws a live boomrat into the wok.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_40: A colonist asks a wise man: "How do I tell if someone will do research?" Wise man: "See whether they're still at the hi-tech research bench during a blackout."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_71: Since a pyromaniac set the fuel alight, the colony has one rule: no playing with fire in the storeroom. The next day the quartermaster adds: and no keeping boomrats in there either.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_41: A researcher falls asleep at the bench and dreams up an anti-thermodynamic machine. He wakes up and writes four words: needs air conditioning.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_109: The colony's dragon girl suddenly learns to open the fridge. Investigation reveals the dog taught her.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_42: An air conditioner breaks. "It's sick," the repairman says. Colonist: "An air conditioner can get sick?" Repairman: "It's installed backwards."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_110: A caravan leader asks the colonist: "Why are there so many penguins here?" Colonist: "They're the locals."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_111: Don't worry about dragon girls overhearing your jokes about them. They don't understand them.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_112: When the power goes out, the colonist lights a campfire. The dog comes over, the cat comes over, the penguin comes over. Penguin: "I'm not actually cold, I just wanted to join in."
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_43: Why are colony funerals always so short? Because the officiant is afraid of the cold.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_44: There was supposed to be a bass joke here, but I forgot to write it.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_113: Two rattkin were about to freeze to death that winter, until a kind-hearted moose took off her bra and gave it to them, and the two rats made it through the cold.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_45: Q: Why is the maths book always gloomy? A: Because it has too many problems.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_46: A fish dares to surf, but never dares to go online.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_114: Nevalline is a mighty ice dragon - or so everyone thought, until a scyther showed up.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_115: Nevalline are afraid of high temperatures, but they're even more afraid of an awkward silence.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_47: Q: Why do snails run so slow? A: They're carrying a house, and the mortgage isn't paid off.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_48: Q: Why does a phone need a case? A: Because a bare phone gets shy.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_116: The snow-cow girl has horns, is strong, is dumb, gives milk and gives wool. I strongly suspect the snow-cow girl is actually a dragon girl?
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_49: Q: Which animal is best at maths? A: The arithmetic (a rat).
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_72: A charge lance needs advanced components, but a scyther doesn't. So who's pocketing the kickback?
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_50: Q: Why doesn't a moose use a computer? A: It's afraid of stepping on the mouse.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_51: Q: Why do stars always blink? A: The sun is too bright; they can't open their eyes.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_117: Vivi never gets lost, because they have a bee-navigation sense.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_118: Nobody cares where Minqiao's ice cream comes from. All hail the nanomachines.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_119: If hitting is affection and scolding is love, the ant race and the moon rabbit have been married billions of times.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_120: Q: Why doesn't a drunk binguin catch small fish? A: Because the small fish are innocent (not guilty/drunk).
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_140: Ty got beaten up by a stranger as a kid, and later found out it was his own uncle.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_121: Q: Which flower blooms the slowest? A: The leisurely orchid.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_52: Q: What gets dirtier the more you wash it? A: Water.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_122: Q: Which race is the quietest? A: The Moyue - nobody can hear her down in the deep sea.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_123: White rain starts falling from the sky. Wait, why are there two ravens?
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_141: Ty ran around bare naked in winter as a kid with just a hat on, and didn't get frostbite.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_124: What illness left Epona unable to move? A: A trojan horse virus.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_53: Q: Which mountain is the gentlest? A: The one you can lean on.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_142: Ty confessed to his classmate fifteen times in one day as a kid, got rejected every time, and decided to become a wild man.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_125: Q: Which race loves hide-and-seek the most? A: The qiluo - because they play cat-and-mouse.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_143: When Ty died he was pushed into the crematorium. After the burning, his clothes suddenly appeared and filled the whole chamber.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_144: Ty got bullied by classmates as a kid. The more pocket money he had, the more people came to beat him up.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_145: Ty kept three chicks as a kid. One died. Ty was so sad that he killed the other two as well.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_126: Q: Why doesn't a penguin wear a down jacket? A: Because it is one.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_54: Clouds just love to follow the crowd.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_55: The first person to get a raise is basically adding fuel to the fire.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_56: Q: Which melon is the most bitter? A: The fool (fool-melon).
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_73: Q: Why is the mechanoid always cold? A: Because its heart (core) is ice.
LanguageData.Binguin_Jokes_57: Q: Which tea is the most refreshing? A: Po-lice (police).

LanguageData.Binguin_WasteRetaliation_LetterText: The binguin have returned the toxic waste we threw at them, exactly as it came - drop pods slammed straight into the colony, unloading {0} bags of toxic waste and {1} enraged boomalopes.
LanguageData.Binguin_BandInvite_Text:
A binguin band has sent word through an intermediary: they wish to hold a concert near your colony.

Build the venue as their marked landmarks show (five instruments), and the band will come and perform. When the performance ends, they will leave a token of thanks on the spot. (It is best to have some chairs to sit on.)

If the finished parts are torn down midway, the performance cannot take place.
LanguageData.Binguin_BandInvite_Accept: No problem, we will see to the venue.
LanguageData.Binguin_Band_TalkToSinger: Ask the lead singer to perform
LanguageData.Binguin_BandQuest_Desc:
A binguin band has sent word through an intermediary: they wish to hold a concert near your colony.

Once you accept, they will drop a [venue marker] near your colony by drop pod - build the venue as the blueprints on the marker show (five instruments).

When the band arrives, right-click the [lead singer] to talk and begin the performance (it is best to have some chairs to sit on).

Note: if the performance has not begun within 4 hours of the band's arrival, someone will urge you on; if 6 hours pass without a performance, they will leave (quest failed).

When the performance ends, the band will leave a token of thanks on the spot.
LanguageData.Binguin_BandMarkerDropped_Text:
The binguin band has sent the venue marker by drop pod.

It is an [installable] marker: find a spacious spot on your map and place it (press R to rotate). Once placed, the blueprints will unfold on their own - simply build as they show.

Once it is built, the band will come.
